cases.name: Fleet manager pages through their vehicles (page 400)
cases.why: The console's vehicle list for one tenant. Offset pagination rereads every earlier page.
cases.change: Keyset pagination (WHERE id > last seen id) instead of OFFSET, plus the composite index (fleet_id, id) so each fleet's vehicles are read in id order.

cases.name: Vehicles per source and powertrain (materialised view)
cases.why: The sources page and reports aggregate the whole vehicle table on every load.
cases.change: Materialised view refreshed when vehicles are added (REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY needs the unique index created with it).
ddl:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_fleet_mix AS SELECT o.key AS oem, v.powertrain, count(*) AS vehicles
                       FROM vehicle v JOIN oem o ON o.id = v.oem_id GROUP BY o.key, v.powertrain
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_mv_fleet_mix ON mv_fleet_mix (oem, powertrain)
